messages.verb.notInstalled: The screens service is not installed. Open the Screens panel and press Install.
messages.verb.noScreen: This workspace has no screen yet: run ostia screen create
messages.verb.ambiguous: This workspace has several screens ({ids}); name one
messages.verb.noWorkspace: Run this from a pane in a workspace
messages.verb.createUsage: usage: ostia screen create [--width N] [--height N] [--allow DOMAIN]... (sizes 64 to 8192)
messages.verb.allowInSandbox: In a sandboxed workspace a screen allows the workspace's domains; --allow is not taken
messages.verb.createRefused: The human did not allow a screen for this workspace
messages.verb.tokenPanesOnly: Only a pane in the screen's workspace gets its token
messages.verb.launchUsage: usage: ostia screen launch [--screen ID] -- program [args...]
messages.create.title: An agent asks for a screen
messages.create.message: An agent in {workspace} wants its own screen.
messages.create.detail: A screen is a separate desktop: what runs there never reaches your display, keyboard or files. You can watch it, take it over and stop it in the Screens panel. Allowing it lets agents in this workspace create screens without asking again, until you revoke it in the panel.
messages.install.reason: The Screens extension needs Xvnc and xdotool to run an agent's screen
messages.install.title: Install the screens service
messages.install.message: Install @aurigax-ai/screens with pnpm for your user?
messages.install.detail: It runs in a new terminal where you see it, and installs under $PNPM_HOME.
messages.install.noManager: No package manager this extension knows was found; install Xvnc (TigerVNC) and xdotool yourself.
messages.panel.missing: The screens service is not installed.
messages.panel.always: Agents in this workspace may create screens without asking.
messages.panel.noWorkspace: Open this panel from a workspace.
messages.domain.title: A screen asks to reach a host
messages.domain.detail: Allow lets only screen {id} reach it until that screen stops. Your workspace's allowed domains do not change.
messages.panel.viewOnly: View only: press Take over to use the keyboard and mouse here.
messages.panel.youHold: You hold the input; the agent waits.
messages.panel.alpha: Alpha: an early version that may change or break.
messages.verb.outdated: screens {version} is too old: {min} or later is needed. Open the Screens panel and press Update.
messages.update.title: Update the screens service
messages.update.message: Update @aurigax-ai/screens with pnpm to the latest version?
messages.panel.outdated: screens {min} or later is needed (this is {version}).
messages.panel.pausedHint: You touched the phone; resume it there
messages.panel.watchOnly: Watching only. The phone's human pauses and resumes it on the phone.
messages.panel.askHint: Ask your phone to start a session for this workspace.
messages.panel.asked: Asked your phone. Nothing starts until you start it there.
messages.verb.askUsage: usage: ostia screen ask-phone --reason TEXT (one line, at most 300 characters, shown on the phone)
messages.verb.askPanesOnly: Only an agent's pane in a workspace asks the phone
messages.verb.askOff: Phone screens are off: the human has not given the Screens extension the phone-screens permission
messages.verb.askStarted: The phone's human started a session; its screen is in ostia screen list
messages.verb.askDeclined: The phone declined: phone control is off there
messages.verb.askNoAnswer: No answer from the phone in 2 minutes
